process.title: How It Works

signup.title: Sign Up & Log In
signup.description: Register with one click, verify your email, and fill out a short business profile.

businessDetails.title: Provide Business Details
businessDetails.description: Enter your business name, industry, opening hours, services/products, and relevant links or documents.

chatWebsite.title: Chat Link & Website Ready

expand.title: Expand Capabilities

difference.question: What makes BizoraOne different from other chat tools?
difference.answer: Unlike standard chatbots, BizoraOne doesn't just reply — it analyzes conversations with your customers and turns them into clear insights and recommendations that help you grow your business.

knowledge.question: Where does the system's knowledge come from?
knowledge.answer: All the information comes directly from the business owner: your products, services, working hours, and FAQs. This ensures the chat is accurate and fully tailored to your business.

analytics.question: What kind of analytics will I see?
analytics.answer: You'll get conversation trends, recurring customer needs, sentiment analysis, and actionable insights that show you what really matters to your customers.

integrations.question: Do you integrate with other systems?
integrations.answer: Not yet. Today the focus is on delivering smart insights and analytics. Integrations with calendars, CRM systems, and marketing tools are on the roadmap.

security.question: How secure is my business data?
security.answer: Your data is encrypted and kept private. Only you control the business details and insights generated from your customer conversations.

gettingStarted.question: How fast can I get started?
gettingStarted.answer: Setup takes minutes: sign up, add your business details, and instantly get your personal chat link to share with customers.
